meta.name: AcademicOS Design System
meta.note: Single source of truth for every design value. Implementations -- CSS, Tailwind, React, Flutter -- generate from this file. Do not hardcode a colour, size or duration anywhere; add it here first. scripts/check_design_tokens.py enforces that.
meta.palette: White-first. The page is white; separation comes from borders and spacing, not fills. All hex values are standard Tailwind v4 palette steps so they are recognisable, greppable and reviewable.
meta.emoji: FORBIDDEN anywhere in the product or its code -- labels, empty states, buttons, errors, commit messages in UI strings, test fixtures. Use a Lucide icon (see icons) or a text label. There is no exception.

brand.comment: indigo. 600 is the interactive brand colour; 700 is hover; 50/100 are the only tints used as fills.

neutral.comment: slate. 0 is the page and every card surface; 50 is the only section fill; 200 borders, 300 stronger borders and disabled text.

semantic.comment: Every status is a triple. Never use a status colour as a bare fill behind text -- use bg with fg, and always pair with a label per the status vocabulary.

dataViz.comment: Five series maximum. Beyond five the chart is illegible, so aggregate the remainder into 'Other' rather than adding a sixth colour.

family.ui: "Inter var", Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
family.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace
family.comment: Inter for everything user-facing, JetBrains Mono for identifiers, codes, timestamps and tabular figures. Two families, no exceptions -- a dashboard's character comes from density and alignment, not from a display typeface.

rules: Never more than three sizes inside one card.
Every number in a table, KPI or chart axis uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Without it columns jitter as values change and comparison -- the whole point of the screen -- breaks.
Sentence case for labels, buttons and headings. Uppercase only for table headers and eyebrow labels, with 0.04em tracking.
No italics in UI. No text-shadow. No letter-spacing other than the two defined.

space.comment: 4px base, matching the Tailwind scale 1:1 so a class name maps to a token without arithmetic. If a value is not on this scale it is a bug, not a preference -- the checker rejects off-scale px values.

interactive.comment: Solid fills for buttons, so no implementer -- human or agent -- has to derive or invent one. Every button state in docs/design-system.md maps to a value here.

border.comment: Borders before shadows. In dense UI a 1px border reads sharper and costs no paint.

shadow.comment: Two levels. Cards use a border and no shadow; only overlays (modal, popover, drawer) cast one.

zIndex.comment: A fixed ladder. Never invent a z-index; never use 9999.

rules: Functional only. No entrance animations on page load, no parallax, no bounce, no spring.
Animate opacity and transform only -- never width, height, top or left.
Honour prefers-reduced-motion: replace transforms with opacity, keep durations.

layout.comment: Tables stretch to contentMaxWidth; prose never exceeds proseMaxWidth (about 72 characters).

rules: Lucide only. No second icon set, no custom SVGs, no emoji as an icon.
An icon never appears without its meaning being available to assistive tech: decorative -> aria-hidden, meaningful -> aria-label or adjacent visible text.
Icons inherit currentColor and never carry their own colour.

focus.comment: Two-ring focus so it reads on both white and tinted backgrounds. Never remove an outline without providing this.

targets.comment: Minimum hit area, not visual size -- a 20px icon button still needs a 44px touch target on mobile.
